basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of ENT, AIIMS, New Delhi, is filling one temporary Project Technical Support III (Optometrist) post in an ICMR funded research project, at 28000/- plus HRA (30%) per the notice. The post needs a Three Years Graduate in the relevant subject/field with Three Years experience, or a Post Graduate in the relevant subject/field, and the age limit is 35 years. Applications are made through the Apply Here link in the notice, and the last date is 22 November 2026. The notice is dated 12 November 2026.

age_limit.details: Category Relaxation SC/ST Up to 5 years OBC Up to 3 years Physically handicapped Up to 10 years Physically handicapped, SC/ST 15 years Physically handicapped, OBC 13 years | The notice states the SC/ST and OBC upper age relaxation as applying "for all categories".

how_to_apply: Apply through the Apply Here link given in the notice on or before 22 November 2026. The notice does not describe the form steps or name any documents to attach.

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi
To conduct the pre compliance and clinical validation of implantable and diagnostic devices (Otorhinolaryngology, Ophthalmic, and Orthopedic) – Project Code I-1750
Department of ENT, AIIMS, New Delhi
Apply Here link in the notice

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS
content_sections.text: AIIMS is the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi. This notice is for a temporary post in a research project funded by ICMR and run in its Department of ENT. The Principal Investigator named in the notice is Dr. Kapil Sikka.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints the minimum essential qualification for Project Technical Support III (Optometrist) as two lines: Three Years Graduate in relevant subject/field + Three Years experience Post Graduate in relevant subject/field Desirable: working experience in Research Projects. The upper age limit is 35 Years. The notice does not print an age cut-off date. For the discipline-specific eligibility, see the official notification. The notice states the SC/ST and OBC upper age relaxation as applying "for all categories".

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is 28000/- + HRA (30%). Joining is December-2026 (Tentatively), and the duration is up to May, 2028. The post is described as temporary and funded under the ICMR project. No TA/DA will be applicable.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Project Technical Support III (Optometrist) Job Description
content_sections.text: Basic eye and vision evaluation using an eye scanner after basic training Coordination with the Ophthalmologist

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Project Technical Support III (Optometrist)
content_sections.text: Apply through the Apply Here link given in the notice on or before 22 November 2026. The notice does not describe the form steps or name any documents to attach.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Technical Support III (Optometrist) posts has AIIMS announced?
faq.answer: AIIMS New Delhi has announced one post of Project Technical Support III (Optometrist) in the Department of ENT.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Optometrist project post?
faq.answer: The last date is 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Technical Support III (Optometrist) at AIIMS?
faq.answer: The notice lists a Three Years Graduate in relevant subject/field + Three Years experience, and a Post Graduate in relevant subject/field. Working experience in Research Projects is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the AIIMS Optometrist project post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 Years. Upper age relaxation is up to 5 years for SC/ST and up to 3 years for OBC; for physically handicapped candidates it is up to 10 years, 15 years for SC/ST and 13 years for OBC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for AIIMS Project Technical Support III (Optometrist)?
faq.answer: The remuneration is 28000/- + HRA (30%).

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the 28000/- remuneration?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice prints the remuneration as 28000/- + HRA (30%).

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the AIIMS Optometrist project post?
faq.answer: Use the Apply Here link given in the notice, before 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How long will the AIIMS Optometrist project post last?
faq.answer: The post is temporary and runs up to May, 2028, with joining in December-2026 (Tentatively).

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for this AIIMS post?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be applicable.

faq.question: Q10. What work does the Optometrist do in this project?
faq.answer: The work profile is basic eye and vision evaluation using an eye scanner after basic training, and coordination with the Ophthalmologist.
